title: Native completion lifecycle markers do not launch background Source content export

scope.renderer: Actual typed native facade/transport, real task/Source stores and completion hook/dialog with controlled canonical native receipts; no Electron preload.
scope.source: Independent actual SQLite/production owner/private-peer/compiled Root controls and two staged stdio entries. Source already strips internal completion flags and local-only completion status before plugin export. The new UI negative proves an extra retained operation attempt, not observed provider data mutation.
scope.platform: Linux x64 only; no installed/native input/live provider acceptance.

expectedActual.expected: Completion markers are local lifecycle state, with one explicit chosen Source action.
expectedActual.actual: Native learning-stop/local-completion/choice marker calls original local task operation directly, retaining canonical receipt checks. It does not pass through the generic task store content-export wrapper.

expectedActual.expected: Retired views and local-only choice launch no background content export.
expectedActual.actual: Project withdrawal+return, unmount and view replacement during held canonical marker produce zero taskSource.exportUpdate calls. Local-only choice produces no Source action/export; actual canonical completed callback still required.

expectedActual.expected: Preserve intended Source completion and legacy behavior.
expectedActual.actual: Captured explicit Source action still executes once after canonical marker and current-view guard, followed by strict completed readback. Accepted markers are not rolled back and unknown actions not replayed. General task content exports and Electron remain unchanged.
